page: Google Cloud Platform t2d-standard-8 is a general-purpose virtual machine instance in the Tau T2D family. It features 8 dedicated vCPUs backed by physical AMD EPYC 7B13 processors running on the x86_64 architecture, operating with 1 thread per core. The instance provides 32.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a 4.0 GB RAM per vCPU ratio. It does not include local NVMe disk storage or discrete GPU accelerators. System cache features 32 KB L1 data cache, 0.5 MB L2 cache, and 32 MB shared L3 cache.

Benchmark performance demonstrates strong single-core CPU execution via stress-ng, scoring in the top 25 percent of instances. Multi-core performance metrics, including a PassMark CPU score of 16769.54 and a Geekbench multi-core score of 7817.0, fall within the average benchmark range. Memory bandwidth read tests record 996.35 GB/sec for cached 16 KB blocks and 95.12 GB/sec for 256 MB uncached blocks. Application benchmarks report static web serving throughput at 11.61 GB/sec and Redis SET performance at 14.93 million operations per second.

The 1:1 thread-to-core allocation provides consistent per-core compute isolation without hyper-threading overhead. Cryptographic and bit-manipulation extensions including AES, VAES, SHA_NI, BMI2, and standard AVX are enabled, though AVX-512 extensions are absent. Due to the lack of built-in persistent local storage, storage must be attached externally. The instance is suited for general web serving, application build automation, medium-scale database workloads, and small model machine learning inference.
description: Google Cloud Platform t2d-standard-8 is a general-purpose instance powered by 8 dedicated AMD EPYC 7B13 physical cores on the x86_64 architecture with 1 thread per core. Equipped with 32.0 GB of RAM (4.0 GB per core), 32 MB of L3 cache, and no bundled local storage or GPUs, it offers a balanced system profile. In benchmark testing, the instance exhibits strong single-core compute performance alongside average multi-core and memory bandwidth results, achieving 11.61 GB/sec static web throughput and 14.93 million Redis SET operations per second. Hardware features include AES, VAES, and AVX instructions, though AVX-512 extensions are omitted. The instance delivers stable resource density for web application hosting, build compilation, database instances, and small-model inference tasks.
